explanation: Prevents placing the bucket next to the sink unless the robot is actually holding it.
Blocks repeated bucket placements once it is already next to the sink.
Ensures the soap must be grasped before attempting to place it inside the bucket.
Prevents unnecessary repeat placements of soap once it is already inside the bucket.
Ensures soaking the dishtowel only when the sink is turned on (water available).
Prevents finishing the task until the bathroom floor stain has been removed.
Stops re-grasping the broom once it is correctly positioned next to the sink.
